best_direction.core_claim: Do not start with the accomplishment. Start at the moment the student recognized something was wrong and changed course — and stay close to what happened next. best_direction.why_this_is_the_real_story: Most of what led up to the correction is context. The essay is the correction itself — and the one moment after it that shows the change was real. best_direction.why_it_beats_the_obvious_angle: A generic framing (general leadership/growth framing) would flatten the story. The evidence points to a good output should connect belief, action, and personal identity, which is more specific and faithful to the axis.
best_direction.main_risk_if_written_poorly: If the essay describes character without a concrete moment of correction, it loses the specificity that makes it work.
best_direction.next_move: Write the moment you got it wrong. Then write the next moment where your corrected approach is visible. Keep only what proves the change was real.
